{{Quote|Name's Targen. Me and my gang are freelancers, and we're here on business.|Targen introduces himself|<ref name="SWTOR" />}}
'''Targen''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked as the head of a [[Targen's gang|freelance gang]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]], he and his men were hired to install [[Listening device/Legends|listening devices]] in the room of the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Red Blade]] at the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Suudaa Nem'ro]]'s [[Nem'ro's Palace|palace]]. While they installed the devices, the Blade; who was actually the [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] [[Imperial Agent|agent]] [[Cipher Nine]], returned and [[Death/Legends|killed]] the freelancers.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Someone wanted to know what you were up to--but I guess that plan's off, now.|Targen explains why he and his gang are in the agent's room|<ref name="SWTOR" />}}
By the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] Targen had come to lead a [[Targen's gang|gang]] of freelancers who worked on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]. In that year he and his men were paid to plant a number of [[Listening device/Legends|listening devices]] in the room of the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Red Blade]], who was staying in the [[Nem'ro's Palace|palace]] of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Suudaa Nem'ro]]. The gang leader brought three of his followers with him to the mercenary's room, two [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] thugs and the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Luunti]]. The group began installing the devices, but were interrupted by the arrival of the Blade, who was, unbeknownst to them, in fact an undercover [[Imperial Agent|agent]] of [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] known as [[Cipher Nine]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

{{GameDSmechanics}}
Targen turned to face the Agent as they entered the room and explained what they were doing, after which the Imperial immediately attacked and killed all four gang members, including Targen.<ref name="SWTOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Come on, Luunti, we don't have time to waste, here.|Targen hurries Luunti|<ref name="SWTOR" />}}
Targen had [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], green [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and tanned skin. Upon being found by who he believed to be the Red Blade, he assumed that the mercenary would attack him and his men. He was unwilling to betray the group who employed him and his men as he did not want to earn their ire, even for triple what he was already being paid.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Equipment==
Targen carried a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] and wore brown [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] while installing the listening devices. He also had [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetics]] installed around his left eye socket.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I don't really want to cross my employer. Plus, you know, we can always grab the credits off your corpse. Guns out, folks.|Targen's response if the player attempts to make a deal|<ref name="SWTOR" />}}
Targen was created for the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. He appeared in the quest "Economies of Scale" which is part of the Imperial Agent class's story on the planet Hutta. Players have the option to immediately attack Targen and his comrades once encountering them for dark side points, trying to make a deal with them for light side points or asking who hired them for no alignment points. This article assumes that players chose the dark side option as the Agent is an Imperial character. If the player attempts to talk to the gang or make a deal with them, Targen refuses to betray his employer and the group attack and are killed anyway.
